0 4 2019 Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center. EDSA corner Quezon Avenue. West Triangle, Quezon City http: /lv.w,v. dilg.gov.ph OILG OPINION No. s. 202 MR. ARIEL B. PENA Assistant Vice President Head Cam Sur Lending Center Development Bank of the Philippines Dear Mr. Pena: This is in reference to your letter dated 9 January 2019 requesting for categorical answer from DILG on whether the specific LGU-proposed projects are eligible to be charged from the 20% development fund (DF). Foremost, please note that Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG)- Department of Budget and Management (DBM) Joint Memorandum Circular (JMC) No. 2017- I dated 22 February 2017 re: "Updated Guidelines on the Appropriation and Utilization of the Twenty Percent (20%) of the Annual Internal Revenue Allotment (IRA) Tor Development Projects" was issued to guide Local Government Units (LGUs) on how to spend their 20% Development Fund. In the General Policies thereof, the following were stated: '2.2 The 20% DF shall be utilized to finance the LGU's priority development projects, as embodied in its duly approved local development plans and Annual Investment Program (AIP), which should be directly supportive of the Philippine Development Plan and Public Investment Program. " 2.3 All development projects to be funded under the 20% DF shall contribute to the attainment of desirable socio-economic development and environmental management outcomes of the LGU, and shall partake the nature of in vestment or capital expenditure "

Thus, the projects that are to be funded by the 20% DF should contribute to the socio- economic or environmental development of an LGU. In your queries (a) and (b), this Department observed that the projects enumerated therein can fall within Item 3.2.4 "Capital expenditures related to the implementation of livelihood r entrepreneurship/local economic development projects. " Therefore, it is allowed. Nonetheless, we agree with DBM that the same should be subject to budgetary limitations under Section 324 Of the Local Government Code, as reiterated in item 3.2.6 of the above-cited JMC. However, in your query (c), this Department notes that among the enumerations were SB session hall and acquisition of service vehicle, which this Department would like to further discuss. Other enumerated items therein can be funded by the 20% DF. This Department already had an occasion to elucidate on the construction of administrative offices in its DILG Opinion No. 23 s. 2017. It provides: "Construction, repair, refinishing of administrative offices It was observed that the "Construction, repair or refinishing of administrative offices" which was specifically enumerated in "Expenditure Items Not Covered (Item 4.0)" under DILG-DBMJMC No. 2011-1 was not anymore included in the list under Item 4.0 of DILG-DBMJMCNo. 2017-1. The exclusion of the said provision in the Item 4.0 can be traced in 2013 wherein after the typhoon Yolanda, this Department received requests for exemption from JMC No. 2011- 1 in order for the LGUs to repair their administrative offices. A joint issuance between the Department and the DBM was crafted to exempt from this provision of the JMC the LGUs declared under State of Calamity. Hence, it is this Department's Vlévv that the construction, repair, refinishing of administrative offices was intentionally removed from Item 4.0 in order for the LGUs to have additional filnding for the construction of their administrative offices which is necessary for the development of every LGU. However, it must be noted that the purchase of administrative office' fixtures, equipment or appliances is still covered by Item 4.0 or it cannot be bought out of the 20% DF of the LGU. " Therefore, SB session hall can be considered an administrative building, hence can be funded by the 20% DF.

Conversely, as to the acquisition of service vehicles, this Department has the opinion that it is included in Item 4.0 (Expenditure Items NOT allowed to be Charged Against the 20% DF), viz: 4.6 Purchase maintenance or repair of motor vehicles or motor cycles, other than those specified in item 3. O hereof. Therefore acquisition of service vehicle cannot be funded by the 20% DF as the same was explicitly excluded by JMC 2017-1. We hope we had addressed your concerns accordingly. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: L C. SACENDONCILLO Undersecretary Copy furnished: Atty. Anthony C. Nuyda, CFSO III Regional Director DILG Region V Legaspi City, Albay Dir.
